title: Pre-Market Brief — 16 Nov 2026
intro:
Crude oil benchmarks are retreating as demand concerns weigh on energy markets alongside broader risk-off sentiment. WTI is lower by 0.72 percent at 87.92 and Brent is down 1.11 percent at 94.78.
Market theme
Risk aversion is dominating the cross-asset landscape as heavy selling hits semiconductors and AI-related equities alongside rising bond yields. The US 10-year yield is up 5.1 basis points to 5.154 percent and the VIX volatility index is surging 6.58 percent to 20.57.
Potential scenario
The base case expects continued downward pressure on tech-heavy indices with Nasdaq futures testing lower levels below 27,664. Alternatively, dip buyers could emerge to support broader equities, keeping S&P 500 futures anchored near 7,537.00.
Key risks
• Escalating sell-off in major semiconductor and artificial intelligence equities following executive departures and export restriction headlines
• Upward pressure on sovereign bond yields with the US 10-year yield climbing to 5.154 percent
